How much is a used AirPods Pro 2 worth?

AirPods Pro 2 resell well but are among the most faked products on second-hand marketplaces. Checking authenticity is the first step.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

There are two versions of the AirPods Pro 2: with a Lightning case (2022) and with a USB-C case (2023). The AirPods Pro 3 followed in 2025. Connected to an iPhone, Settings shows the exact model and serial number, which you can check on Apple's coverage site.

What decides the price

  • Authenticity: fakes are common. A genuine pair shows the correct serial in Settings and on Apple's coverage check.
  • Battery: battery wear lowers the price.
  • Case: USB-C or Lightning, scratches, the speaker and lanyard loop.
  • Completeness: both earbuds, the case and spare tips.

Check before you buy

  • Pair with an iPhone: check the model, serial and firmware in Settings.
  • Check the serial number on Apple's coverage website.
  • Make sure they are removed from the seller's Apple ID (Find My).
  • Test noise cancelling and transparency mode on both earbuds.

Where it sells best

Tiny and cheap to ship, sells on eBay and Vinted. Buyers worry about fakes, so show the serial number check and the original box.

Today's price

Prices for a used AirPods Pro 2 change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. FlipLens reads current eBay listings for the exact model and condition, removes bundles, broken items and other models, and shows a quick-sale, expected and high price, your profit after fees and the most to pay. Questions

How much is a used AirPods Pro 2 worth?

It depends on case type, battery, authenticity and Find My lock. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Apple AirPods Pro 2" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

How can I tell if AirPods Pro 2 are fake?

Pair them with an iPhone and check the serial in Settings and on Apple's coverage site. Fakes often show the wrong model, a reused serial or no proper noise cancelling.

Can I sell a single AirPod or the case alone?

Yes, single earbuds and cases sell as replacements, but for much less than a full set.
